hypothesis.architecture: frozen BGE-M3 query embeddings, one normalized R207 prototype centroid per typed family, and a separately trained class-balanced binary domain head
hypothesis.difference_from_r236_r241_r243_r246_r250: uses a strict query-disjoint R207 train/evaluation split for all 31 families rather than any reused PRESTO/MASSIVE partition, catalogue-document maximum, cross-encoder family head, or the R253-infeasible source selection

selection.inside: deduplicate R207 positive query/family pairs; reserve SHA-256 first one per family then SHA-256 remainder to exactly 256 evaluation queries; every remaining normalized query is prototype/domain training only
selection.overlap_rule: no normalized query may occur in both prototype training and inside evaluation, even under a different operation label

training.inside: R207 positive queries from the training side of the split
training.domain_loss: binary cross entropy with positive class weight calculated from frozen split counts
